tours.route: Arusha → Lake Manyara → Serengeti → Ngorongoro Crater → Tarangire → Arusha
tours.accommodation: Nsya Camp; Seronera Campsite; Simba Campsite
tours.title: The Serengeti Symphony
tours.description: A classic 6-day Northern Circuit safari combining Lake Manyara, the Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, and Tarangire. Experience diverse landscapes, the Big Five, large elephant herds, predators, and the possibility of witnessing the Great Migration.

tours.route: Arusha → Tarangire → Serengeti → Ngorongoro Crater → Arusha
tours.title: Tanzania Big Five Signature
tours.description: A fast-paced 5-day Northern Circuit safari designed around Tanzania's legendary Big Five. Explore Tarangire's elephant country, the predator-rich Serengeti, and the wildlife-filled Ngorongoro Crater.

tours.route: Arusha → Tarangire → Central Serengeti → Migration Areas → Ngorongoro Crater → Lake Manyara → Arusha
tours.title: The Great Migration Horizon
tours.description: An 8-day safari focused on experiencing the Great Migration across the Serengeti. Spend multiple days tracking wildebeest and zebra herds while exploring predator-rich plains, followed by Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara.

tours.route: Dar es Salaam → Nyerere National Park → Ruaha National Park → Mikumi / Morogoro → Dar es Salaam
tours.accommodation: Karatu Tented Camp; Embalakai Luxury Tented Camp; Ngorongoro Ang'ata Tented Camp
tours.title: The Untamed South
tours.description: An 8-day Southern Circuit adventure through the wild landscapes of Nyerere and Ruaha National Parks. Experience boat safaris, walking experiences, remote game drives, African wild dogs, lions, elephants, and rugged southern wilderness.

tours.route: Arusha → Tarangire → Mto wa Mbu → Lake Manyara → Maasai Boma → Ngorongoro → Lake Eyasi → Arusha
tours.accommodation: Roika Tented Camp; Karatu Tented Camp; Embalakai Luxury Tented Camp; Ngorongoro
tours.title: The Family Karibu Safari
categories: Family, Big Five, Cultural, Short Breaks
tours.description: A family-focused 6-day Tanzania adventure combining wildlife, culture, and interactive experiences. Explore Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro, Mto wa Mbu, and Lake Eyasi with activities designed to keep families and younger travelers engaged.

tours.route: Arusha → Tarangire → Serengeti → Ngorongoro → Arusha → Zanzibar → Stone Town → Nungwi / Kendwa
tours.accommodation: Meru View Lodge; Ang'ata Tarangire Tented Camp; Kirurumu Manyara Tented Camp; Ang'ata Serengeti Tented Camp; Ang'ata Ngorongoro Tented Camp; Kisima Ngeda Tented Camp
tours.title: The Bush & Blue Escape
tours.description: A 13-day Tanzania holiday combining an unforgettable Northern Circuit safari with a relaxing Zanzibar beach escape. Experience Tarangire, Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Stone Town, spice farms, tropical beaches, snorkeling, and island adventures.

tours.route: Arusha → Lake Manyara → Ngorongoro Crater → Lake Eyasi → Mto wa Mbu → Arusha
tours.accommodation: Tarangire Acacia Tented Camp; Manyara Secret Lodge; Malaika Luxury Camp; Lion's Paw Ngorongoro Luxury Camp; Zanzibar accommodation
tours.title: Rhythms of the Rift Valley
tours.description: A 4-day journey through Tanzania's Great Rift Valley combining wildlife, dramatic landscapes, birdwatching, and cultural experiences. Discover Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro Crater, and the communities around Lake Eyasi and Mto wa Mbu.

tours.route: Arusha → Tarangire → Serengeti → Ngorongoro Crater → Karatu → Arusha
tours.accommodation: Airport Planet Lodge; Arusha Planet Lodge; Ang'ata Tarangire Tented Camp; Lake Natron Tented Camp; Malaika Luxury Camp; Speke Bay Lodge; Lion's Paw Camp
tours.title: Timeless Savannah Romance
tours.description: A romantic 7-day safari designed for couples, honeymooners, and anniversary celebrations. Enjoy intimate luxury camps, private game drives, sunset sundowners, optional balloon safaris, Serengeti wildlife, and spectacular Ngorongoro views.

tours.route: Moshi → Mount Kilimanjaro → Materuni → Tarangire → Serengeti → Ngorongoro → Arusha
tours.title: The Roof of Africa & Beyond
tours.description: A 10-day Tanzania adventure combining Mount Kilimanjaro experiences with a classic wildlife safari. Trek through Kilimanjaro's rainforest, visit Materuni Waterfalls, explore Tarangire and Serengeti, and discover the wildlife of Ngorongoro Crater.

tours.title: Serengeti Under Canvas
tours.description: A 4-day fly-in Serengeti experience focused on maximizing time in the wilderness. Stay in an intimate canvas camp, enjoy game drives across the plains, track the Great Migration, and experience the Serengeti under the stars.

tours.route: Moshi / Arusha → Londorossi Gate → Mti Mkubwa → Shira 2 → Lava Tower → Barranco → Karanga → Barafu → Uhuru Peak → Mweka → Moshi / Arusha
tours.title: Kilimanjaro Expedition
tours.description: An 8-day summit-focused Mount Kilimanjaro expedition using the Lemosho or Machame route. Trek through rainforest, moorland, alpine desert, and high-altitude terrain before attempting the summit of Uhuru Peak at 5,895 meters.

tours.route: Arusha → Tarangire → Ngorongoro Crater → Lake Manyara → Arusha
tours.title: Echoes of the Ngorongoro
tours.description: A compact 3-day Northern Circuit safari combining Tarangire, Ngorongoro Crater, and Lake Manyara. Experience elephants, lions, leopards, flamingos, tree-climbing lions, and the unique wildlife of the Ngorongoro ecosystem.
